result.title: When Self-Consistency Hurts: The Hidden Cost of Majority Voting in Small Language Models
result.comment: 15 pages, 3 figures, 2 tables. Accepted by the 33rd International Conference on Neural Information Processing (ICONIP 2026)
result.summary: We study prompted chain-of-thought (CoT) with self-consistency (SC), i.e. sampling N traces and plurality-voting, on small language models, a regime where per-query compute budgets are tight yet SC is commonly applied with a fixed sample budget inherited from large-model practice, regardless of instance difficulty. Across two model families (Qwen-2.5-0.5B, Gemma-3-1B) at FP16 and MLX-Q4 (4-bit quantisation in Apple's MLX framework), on GSM8K and MATH-500, we run 8 per-task and 4 task-pooled experiments at n=200-400 with 1,000x paired-bootstrap confidence intervals (CIs). Our first result is an upper bound: an oracle gate deciding per prompt whether to invoke SC reaches 109-174% of always-SC's accuracy at 23-30% of its compute in all 12/12 cases, so at N=5 always-SC is dominated everywhere on our grid. That margin is exactly the rate at which SC flips correct greedy answers to wrong, here 3-10.5% of prompts, which on Qwen-Q4 x MATH-500 exceeds the wrong-to-right rate and leaves always-SC 3 pt worse than always-greedy. Our second result is a deployable approximation: a gate over greedy-pass signals skips 45-99% of SC calls, with bootstrap CI half-widths under 5 pt, removing 36-79% of always-SC compute. Accuracy retention at those operating points has point estimates of 98.1-98.8%, which we report as point estimates because their CIs are wide (lower bounds 76-86%) over an SC accuracy of only 15-36%. The evidence covers N=5 on two <=1B families and two math benchmarks, which is the scope we claim. Code is available at https://github.com/heywanrong/SiftSC.

AI.brief_summary: 论文在 ≤1B 小模型上考察带自洽性（采样多条 CoT 并多数投票）的提示推理，用 oracle 门控给出上界，并提出基于贪心解信号的近似门控，从而跳过大部分采样调用、节省算力。
AI.relevance_reason: 多数投票会把原本正确的贪心答案翻成错误的诊断，以及「是否值得再花算力采样、如何聚合多假设」的门控思路，可供核查 LVR 中多 latent 采样聚合与 STOP 决策的收益成本；但对象是纯文本数学任务，迁移属推测。
